macros.name: addOCG
macros.doc: Adds the Optional Content Group <object number> to the document's catalog, with base state off.

macros.name: addproperties
macros.doc: Maps <name> to <object number> in the Properties dictionary of the current page's Resources.

macros.name: addtoeachpageobject
macros.doc: This adds <code> to the Page object for all pages.

macros.name: addtopageobject
macros.doc: This adds <code> to the Page object for the current page.

macros.name: addtopageresources
macros.doc: This adds <code> to the Resources dictionary for all pages.

macros.name: anchor
macros.doc: This creates an anchor called <name>, which is a destination for the \goto command.

macros.name: createbookmark
macros.doc: This creates a bookmark with <text> as the text displayed in the outline panel and the pop-up menu.

macros.name: Date
macros.doc: The document's date, recorded in the macro \Date.

macros.name: firstslide
macros.doc: Go to the presentation's first slide.

macros.name: gotoA
macros.doc: This creates the first item of a bidirectional link called <name>.

macros.name: gotoB
macros.doc: This creates the second item of a bidirectional link called <name>.

macros.name: hidegrids
macros.doc: Hides all grids on following slides, as if \showgrid had never been called.

macros.name: lastslide
macros.doc: Go to the presentation's last slide.

macros.name: newimage
macros.doc: This loads image file <file>, setting its dimensions to <width> and <height>; if none are present, the image has its natural width; if only one dimension is given, the other ones is scaled accordingly.

macros.name: nextslide
macros.doc: Go to the presentation's next slide.

macros.name: nextstep
macros.doc: Go forward once.

macros.name: position
macros.doc: This puts <material> inside <area>.

macros.name: presentationonly
macros.doc: In presentation mode, <material> is simply typeset.

macros.name: presentationorhandout
macros.doc: In presentation mode, the first argument is executed, and the second one in handout mode.

macros.name: prevslide
macros.doc: Go to the presentation's previous slide.

macros.name: prevstep
macros.doc: Go backward once.

macros.name: setarea
macros.doc: To create an area, or to modify an existing one, this command is used with <list of areas> being area names separated by space; thus attributes similar for several areas can be declared at once.

macros.name: setstep
macros.doc: You can create new types of slides or steps and set their parameters with the \setslide and \setstep commands respectively.

macros.name: showbookmarks
macros.doc: This creates an hbox containing <text> (which can be anything, like real text, or a symbol, etc.); when clicked, a pop-up menu appears, which contains the bookmark hierarchy of the document.

macros.name: showgrid
macros.doc: This displays a grid on top of the slides (following the command) to ease the creation of a display.

macros.name: showorhide
macros.doc: This shows or hides the steps referred to in <actions>, which is made of `<action>=<step list>' pairs separated by commas, where <action> is on, off or toggle, and <step list> is a list of step names separated by space.

macros.name: step
macros.doc: To make the content of a slide appear progressively on the screen, this command is used where necessary.

macros.name: usecolor
macros.doc: This typesets <text> with the specified color, overriding whatever is used as the current color wherever this command is issued (i.e. step, slide, area).

macros.name: useimage
macros.doc: This returns an hbox containing the image <name>.
